rendered.subject: Collaboration Proposal
rendered.body:
Hi Outdoor Voices team,

We are a small Instagram content studio and would like to propose a collaborative post with you. We are Outdoor Voices, a brand that designs technical apparel for recreation, specifically creating the uniform for doing things with materials made for movement [P1]. You collaborate with a wide range of influencers, from fitness enthusiasts to lifestyle bloggers, to promote your products [P3]. Outdoor Voices challenges disruptive activewear brands like Challenge Outdoor Voices, hiring Blinker to improve re-engagement with lapsed customers through their email marketing [P9].

The proposed post would be a collaborative Instagram post, created together with your team. It would showcase a visually appealing image or short video featuring a key element of Outdoor Voices’s design philosophy – perhaps a moment of movement or a detail of the apparel. We envision working together to build a shared visual experience that resonates with your audience.

Please reply if you’d like to discuss this further.

The BrandPilot team
